enchantments.tooltip: Proof Against Poison +10: This item grants its wearer immunity to natural poisons. This item also grants a +10 Enhancement bonus to saving throws against magical poisons, and the wearer does not fail saving throws against them on a roll of a natural 1 (this renders the wearer immune to magical poisons with a DC of less than 11 + their Fortitude save).
Deathblock VIII: Passive: 24% Enhancement Bonus to Negative Energy Absorption. In addition, you are immune to magical effects that can cause instant death.
Good Luck +3: This item gives a +3 Luck bonus to all saves and skill checks.
Superior False Life: This item grants the wearer +40 maximum health.
